meta.name: copywriting
meta.description: When the user wants to write, rewrite, or improve marketing copy for any page — including homepage, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, about pages, or product pages. Also use when the user says "write copy for," "improve this copy," "rewrite this page," "marketing copy," "headline help," "CTA copy," "value proposition," "tagline," "subheadline," "hero section copy," "above the fold," "this copy is weak," "make this more compelling," or "help me describe my product." Use this whenever someone is working on website text that needs to persuade or convert. For email copy, see emails. For popup copy, see popups. For editing existing copy, see copy-editing. For the offer underneath the copy (bonuses, guarantees, value framing), see offers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化网站文案以提升转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站页面撰写或优化营销文案。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize website copy to boost conversion rates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write or improve marketing copy for web pages.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你撰写、改写或优化网站营销文案，包括首页、落地页、定价页、功能页、关于页等。它会先收集页面目的、受众、产品信息等背景，然后按照清晰、具体、以客户语言为主的原则输出文案，并附上写作理由和备选方案。
howto.when: 当你要求写或改进营销文案，或说出“write copy for”、“improve this copy”、“rewrite this page”、“marketing copy”、“headline help”、“CTA copy”等关键词时触发。也适用于需要说服或转化的网站文本。

say.text: 帮我写一个首页的标题和副标题，目标客户是中小企业主。
say.note: Claude 会先询问背景，然后输出文案。

say.text: 这段落地页文案太弱了，帮我改得更吸引人。
say.note: Claude 会分析原文并给出改进版本。

say.text: 为我的定价页写一个CTA按钮文案。
say.note: Claude 会提供多个选项并解释理由。
